name: Mall Floor Edge Trim
summary: A slim 1.2 m trim strip for the existing mall floor grid.
description: A two-piece straight visual edge trim aligned to the 1.2 m mall floor module.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender geometry and Principled materials; no external models or textures.

assembly.origin: top centre at finished floor level; Blender +Z / glTF +Y up
assembly.placement: For a floor root at (0,-0.03,0), place the trim at (0,0,0.63) glTF metres.

rights: Original geometry and materials created for the owner project. Public redistribution terms not specified.
accuracy_notes: Visual trim only; no structural, slip, installation or safety certification.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and materials created for Blender-3D-Gallery.

quality_gate.scope: Straight edge only; corner finish, full assembly, physical devices and target performance remain unverified.
